feeds.title: Dedola Blog
feeds.description: Dedola Global Logistics (DGL) provides logistics and freight management solutions for importers and exporters worldwide. DGL currently manages a full matrix of logistics services within all trade lanes of the world, in the air, over land and on the sea.

feeds.title: Conqueror Blog
feeds.description: The Conqueror Freight Network (CQR) brings together carefully-selected freight forwarders in each major city who cooperate reciprocally and securely to expand their businesses, reduce costs and risks, and compete on more equal terms against the largest international companies.

feeds.title: Approved Freight Forwarders
feeds.description: Since 1991, Approved Freight Forwarders has dedicated itself to the unique shipping needs of the Hawaii and Guam trades. We are a family-owned-and- operated company and the only freight forwarder in Hawaii to have its own trucks and warehouses on all four islands. We accommodate all types of commodities and all sizes of freight for both business and individual clients. Our highly trained logistics experts use advanced technology to tailor shipping solutions that fit your specific requirements.

feeds.title: FORWARDER Magazine » Airfreight
feeds.description: Forwarder is the only magazine that gives you the first, fastest, and greatest insight into everything freight. It is a multi-platform publication that can take readers one step further into the world of distribution and logistics through the use of print, web, and social media. This provides pivotal moment-by-moment access for their readers enabling them to delve into information on the spot. Visit their blog and learn more about the latest news, updates, videos, articles, and more.

feeds.title: Falcon Freight
feeds.description: Falcon initiated its journey in 1989. Mr. Vikas Gupta - the pioneer and founder of Falcon India established it three decades ago in Delhi. We provide custom clearing, shipping/ forwarding & product sourcing across India and abroad. We offer 360-degree solutions to our valuable customers and unrivaled solutions to expand their reach to every corner of the world.

feeds.title: International Cargo Express Blog
feeds.description: International Cargo Express is an Australian-owned freight forwarder with over 34+ years' of experience in all facets of international shipping. Exceptional customer service is what sets us apart. Unlike bigger players in the market, our business structure allows us to provide a boutique freight forwarding experience to every client, excelling at proactive communication, attention to detail and experienced professional advice.

feeds.title: Logitude World Blog
feeds.description: Logitude World provides freight forwarders with the first true SaaS freight forwarding software solution. Logitude's cloud solution encompasses the latest freight management software for optimal functionality, covering the full freight forwarding lifecycle. The easy-to-use freight forwarding system consists of several freight forwarder software modules.

feeds.title: SLR Shipping LLC Blog
feeds.description: SLR SHIPPING SERVICES is a Multimodal and International Freight Forwarding and logistics company in Dubai, UNITED ARAB EMIRATES with an extensive network around the world. We are committed to providing our best service to our Clients. Our Team is very highly professional in handling all types of cargo whether small parcel to container or Project and breakbulk Cargo. We provide innovative logistic solutions under one roof to modern logistic challenges and fulfill the client's requirements with satisfaction.

feeds.title: Super International Shipping Blog
feeds.description: Delve into comprehensive insights into the intricate world of logistics, imports, and shipping involving China. Super International Shipping (SIS) is a leading freight forwarder in China specializing in sea shipping, air freight, road truck freight, rail freight, FBA Express Shipping, and DDP Shipping.

feeds.title: KG Logistics Blog
feeds.description: KG Logistics is an independent freight forwarding and logistics company based in the UK. We have over 35 years of combined experience working as independent freight forwarding specialists. Find the latest industry news and blog articles relating to the freight forwarding and logistics industry, written by experts.

feeds.title: CSA Software Blog
feeds.description: CSA Software products are designed for the unique needs of freight forwarders and their clients, vendors, and overseas business partners. CSA Software provides the end-to-end, industry-leading solutions, and the expertise you need to increase operational efficiency and drive competitive advantage. Read and learn about how to grow your freight forwarding business through state-of-the-art software such as World-Trak, LTL-Trak, WMS-Trak, and more!

feeds.title: Newage Blog
feeds.description: Newage is famous for its freight forwarding software and Logistics Back Office Services, which fulfill the needs of ever-changing logistics and supply chain industries. Our goal is to be the trusted technology solution partner to the global logistics and freight forwarding industry. We are the experts in innovative and creative technology solutions providers for businesses to get the best out of their resources very effectively.

feeds.title: RAKS International Pte Blog
feeds.description: An accredited member of the Singapore Logistics Association, Raks International Pte Ltd is a total logistics services provider. Raks is able to offer a wide spectrum of in-house services, effectively reducing overhead and in turn providing our customers with competitive rates. We pride ourselves on being a reliable freight forwarder in Singapore and are able to cater to your specific needs by tapping on our wide network of service partners in the region.

feeds.title: MarcoPoloLine Blog
feeds.description: MarcoPoloLine is an authority in the field of Exporting and Importing cargo, and all the affiliated industries related to freight forwarding. MPL has a network of offices strategically positioned in virtually every angle of the globe, giving us the advantage of being able to offer our clients a comprehensive service. MPL evaluates the customers' requirements and provides transportation solutions designed specifically for them, whilst speeding up consignments efficiently and cost-effectively, tracking every shipment through each destination, whether it be by air, sea, train, or road.

feeds.title: GoFreight Blog
feeds.description: GoFreight is a customer-first freight software expert revolutionizing the freight forwarding industry. Backed by world-class investors and industry experts, we dedicate ourselves to solving real problems for skilled freight forwarders and their customers.

feeds.title: Cargologik Blog
feeds.description: Cargologik is here to facilitate trade, foster collaboration, and promote the well-being of independent forwarders, shippers, and their customers. Stay up-to-date with the latest freight forwarding management news. Our freight forwarding management blog provides tips for your global logistics efforts.

feeds.title: DFREIGHT Blog
feeds.description: We aim to shed light on the traditional transportation market and make it transparent, easy, and cost-effective. Also, we provide the ultimate customer experience with self-service order handling and live real-time tracking that brings efficiency to different layers of your supply chain management.

feeds.title: Packair Blog
feeds.description: With over 50 years of experience in the international transportation, logistics, and shipping industries, Packair has successfully transported everything from high-value, rare, and oddly shaped cargo to all corners of the world. Through our high standard of care in the full range of international logistics services we provide, we have built long-lasting relationships with numerous high-profile clients.
